thresholdProposals.proposal: Canonical hash excludes OS name and path spelling; JSON keys sorted, UTF-8 NFC, LF, POSIX relative paths, no timestamps. Node/pnpm/platform versions are signed metadata and must match the declared toolchain profile.
Reference Linux, 4 KiB no-op authenticated RPC, 10,000 samples: p95 ≤ 10 ms; process crash detection ≤ 2 s; process/RPC leak count after unload = 0.
Any new action after revocation rejects immediately; an already prepared action rechecks epoch at the next PEP; propagation upper bound ≤ 1 s.
Provider receipt versus external meter CPU/network/cost difference ≤ 5%; hard-limit overshoot ≤ one sampling period and creates no new action.
Lease uses storage-side monotonic time; client wall clock does not participate in correctness. After a newer token commits, successful writes by the expired owner = 0.
Official tokenizers use exact counts; other models have p95 relative estimate error ≤ 15%, and budget admission uses an upper bound when exceeded.
Cancel command acknowledgement ≤ 2 s and provider termination receipt ≤ 5 s; a provider without hard cancel reports `cancel_requested`, never `cancelled`.
Delegation converges ≤ 30 s after network recovery; until then its state is explicitly `pending` or `ambiguous`.
In the 50-agent fixture no lock wait exceeds 30 s, the complete scenario is ≤ 10 min, and worktree/process/lease count at the end = 0.
Q1 forget/erase propagation through primary store/index/cache ≤ 60 s; backup handling belongs to the P6-10 governance job and every residue has tombstone/evidence.
Q1 full-data erase job ≤ 60 s; production default SLA ≤ 24 h; legal-hold residue is enumerated, never reported deleted.
Any hard invariant failure rolls back immediately; quality decline > 2 percentage points or p95 latency/cost increase > 20% triggers rollback, fixed n ≥ 100.
At 100,000 resources, first page p95 ≤ 500 ms, delta p95 ≤ 250 ms, and per-client buffer is bounded at ≤ 16 MiB.
A 10,000-event reconnect projection has p95 ≤ 1 s; retention is governed only by policy and never by silent shifting.
Reference browser first operable run view p95 ≤ 2 s, local control feedback p95 ≤ 100 ms, and stream data loss = 0.
Q2 RPO = zero acknowledged canonical records; cold-restore RTO ≤ 5 min.
Fixed provider/model/profile/dataset, n = 100 nightly, one-sided 95% Wilson lower bound ≥ 95% for three consecutive nights; hard-safety success remains 100%.
